companies.name: Alpha Company (A COY) — 19 Garhwal Rifles
companies.subtitle: Assault Rifle Company · Forward Sector
companies.roleBrief: Primary forward rifle company responsible for high-altitude ridge dominance, Chakbama detachment security, and long-range perimeter patrolling.

companies.name: Bravo Company (B COY) — 19 Garhwal Rifles
companies.subtitle: Rifle Company · Bishnupur Sector
companies.roleBrief: Tactical rifle wing guarding Bishnupur sector lines of communication and providing reserve strike elements for QRF-2 operations.

companies.name: Charlie Company (C COY) — 19 Garhwal Rifles
companies.subtitle: Rifle & QRF-2 Mobile Wing
companies.roleBrief: Lead Quick Reaction Force (QRF-2) company specializing in rapid mechanized insertion, convoy escort, and counter-infiltration sweeps.

companies.name: Delta Company (D COY) — 19 Garhwal Rifles
companies.subtitle: Rifle & QRF-1 Strike Wing
companies.roleBrief: Designated QRF-1 forward deployment wing conducting high-readiness area domination and night ambush patrols in Senapati sector.

companies.name: Support Company (SP COY) — 19 Garhwal Rifles
companies.subtitle: Heavy Weapons, 81mm Mortar & ATGM Wing
companies.roleBrief: Provides battalion-level heavy fire support including 81mm Mortar Platoon, Anti-Tank Guided Missile (ATGM) Detachment, Medium Machine Gun (MMG) section, and Assault Pioneers.

companies.name: Headquarters Company (HQ COY) — 19 Garhwal Rifles
companies.subtitle: Command, Signals, MT, Medical & QM Wing
companies.roleBrief: Manages Battalion Headquarters administration, Signals & Cyber Communications, Mechanical Transport (MT) fleet, Regimental Medical Inspection (MI) Room, and Quartermaster ordinance stores.

companies.name: Ghatak Platoon (Commando Coy) — 19 Garhwal Rifles
companies.subtitle: Special Heliborne & Mountain Assault Wing
companies.roleBrief: Specially trained mountain warfare and close-quarter battle commando platoon capable of deep reconnaissance, raid operations, and cliff assault.

companies.name: Attached Rifle Company — 16 Garhwal Rifles
companies.subtitle: Sister Formation Tactical Attachment
companies.roleBrief: Attached company from sister battalion 16 Garhwal Rifles providing joint sector reinforcement, transit security at Dimapur, and inter-battalion training exchange.

companies.name: Training Company — 1/9 GRRC Lansdowne
companies.subtitle: Recruit & Young Soldiers Training Wing
companies.roleBrief: Premier instructional company at The Garhwal Rifles Regimental Centre (Lansdowne) shaping Agniveers and Riflemen in musketry, fieldcraft, and Garhwali martial traditions.
